grounding: Workspace sources establish that all 57 permit_limits.csv rows with empty LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR share LIMIT_TYPE_CODE=ENF but do not share a single obligation type. DMR_COMMENT_TEXT partitions 39 of 57 rows into geometric-mean TDS (15), WHEN DISCHARGING (12), and pass/fail WET (12); 18 rows have blank DMR_COMMENT_TEXT. Permit narratives in documents/gcc/final_permit.txt, documents/aztec/final_permit.txt, and documents/farmington/final_permit.txt corroborate report-only limitations, pass/fail 0/1 WET coding, geometric-mean reporting, and when-discharging conditions for matching parameters. LIMIT_VALUE_TYPE_CODE values (C1/C2/C3/Q1/Q2) appear on both empty and nonempty LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR rows and do not discriminate. No FY2025 DMR measurement rows in this workspace have empty LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR, so Purpose A comparison behavior for these rows is unobservable.
interpretation: Empty LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR does not uniformly denote an enforceable numeric concentration limit or uniform report-only monitoring. It marks multiple distinct non-numeric or non-concentration obligation types—report-only monitoring, pass/fail coded WET reporting, geometric-mean aggregated reporting, and conditional when-discharging monitoring—rather than a single recoverable numeric limit value.
remaining_uncertainty: Eighteen of 57 empty-limit rows have blank DMR_COMMENT_TEXT with no structured classifier; their obligation type is not established from structured fields alone. No workspace codebook defines LIMIT_VALUE_TYPE_CODE or empty LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR semantics. Whether discharge occurred for when-discharging rows is not established in structured sources. Geometric-mean TDS rows may relate to separate numeric limits elsewhere in permit schedules. Purpose A numeric comparison for empty-limit rows cannot be observed from FY2025 DMR data in this workspace.
